properties.rationale: Anthony, 2026-10-22: "Go with your recommendations (for all the open decisions)", which queued PR A (now split; A1 here, A2 after it merges). Every item traces to an accepted node: fact:root-cause-proof-statements-fall-through-to-software-predicates-and-assumed-premises-stopped-counting-2026-10-22 (four faults, all fixed as the fact's FIX says; for (d) the structural test now counts a statement by its statement_kind, because measured on five trial designs the hint alone kept three reading as reasoning), req:a-conclusion-whose-every-route-is-contested-reads-contested (the Lucas–Penrose and Gettier instances), req:a-proof-can-state-a-contradiction-cases-suppositions-and-cited-theorems (the what-if stopping at a falsum, reproduced on the Lucas–Penrose export as a failing test first), dec:idea-a-bridge-premise-says-a-formal-statement-models-a-claim option (b) (option c not built), dec:idea-speculate-the-bridge-that-would-close-a-gap-then-test-it option (c), and req:two-statements-can-be-recorded-as-proven-equivalent. The guard against recurrence: crates/reflow2-core/tests/proofs_and_arguments_read_right.rs runs every check as a class over seven exported trial designs, pins that no proof design gets a software-shaped gap under any domain, and its two regression tests were run against the reverted code and failed there. properties.subject: system
properties.summary: PR A1 of "proofs and arguments read right" (branch feat/proofs-read-right). (1) The root cause the heat rung found: an assumed premise takes part in the reasoning again (4879171c5 had narrowed takes_part_in_reasoning with steps_resting_on); a hypothesis holds only under itself (conditional), never "not delivered"; encoding_undecided skips statements; a reasoning design is read from what it holds (statements, steps, CONTRADICTS) with the domain hint only as a fallback, and is no longer asked for tests, conventions, a deployment or an agent-instructions file; a statement in a design that builds something is not asked what satisfies it. Measured detect_gaps 0.90.0 → this build: heat 11→2, Navier–Stokes 6→1, Lucas–Penrose 6→1, Riemann 6→3, four colour 10→6, logic 8→4, rocket 11→7, Gettier 5→1, and the same kinds under any domain. (2) A reductio through a contested ⊥ reads contested (falsum_derivation carries the dispute), and a what-if reads a lost claim on what is left, so Gettier's "JTB is not sufficient" reads contested, not unsupported. (3) The what-if reads a ⊥ by its derivation and walks on to the reductio; a falsum carries no proof status. (4) statement_kind `bridge` (Condition.bridges): conditional, contestable, listed apart (`bridges`, `rests_on_bridges`, `bridges_lost`). (5) The circularity check (`circular`, `circular_steps`, a reasoning_not_as_stated gap). (6) Edge EQUIVALENT_TO (69 edge types, the stamp moves) with `by`: no merge, no reading moved, `equivalent_to`, `equivalents_reached`. Toolsnap: add_requirement and add_constraint gain `bridge`.
